sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: backing, parking, passenger restraints, crashes, insurance and phones
Knowledge facts: part C holds 45 fact blocks (sec06-F01 onward) from physical pages 38 to 43; part C2 holds 27 confusable and continuation blocks (sec06-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer (physical page 3), the June 2026 edition (physical page 1), the written test format, the 80 percent passing score, the one-test-per-day rule, the retest fee and the vision minimums from physical page 13; the question count and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MN-TRAFFICB-A-COUNT — written test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MN-TRAFFICB-A-TIME — written test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MN-TRAFFICB-D-PHONE — the phone paragraph covers messaging and internet use only; confirm the full scope the written test expects (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- MN-TRAFFICB-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MN-TRAFFICB-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the reinstatement fee, uninsured-vehicle penalties, repeat messaging fine and the Office of Traffic Safety web address are isolated in the Dynamic facts line of part C.

corpus_stability.reason: The Minnesota Driver’s Manual prints a single edition line (June 2026) on its front cover and opens with a New laws and information chapter that collects recent changes in one place, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
